The programme will build the knowledge and confidence of the learner to have a conversation if they are concerned that someone may be self-harming. The training programme should provide people who access it with a sense of hope and reassurance that people can build healthier coping mechanisms. Programme Objectives The training programme is intended to: Increase understanding of what self-harm is. Increase understanding of the relationship between self-harm and suicide. Challenge the stigma surrounding self-harm Increase awareness of available supports and services Stage 1: An introduction to the subject of self-harm – communicating the ‘why’ functions of self-harm through lived experience experts. STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi

Lepingu objekti rakenduses kasutatakse Microsoft 365 keskkond a, mis säilitab logisid vastavalt Microsofti teenustingimustele ja üldmäärusele, EL majanduspiirkonnas. Pakkumuse vastavustingimused on esitatud RHR-i rubriigis „Vastavustingimused“. 4.2. Hankija kontrollib esitatud pakkumuse vastavust RHAD-s esitatud tingimustele ning teeb põhjendatud kirjaliku otsuse pakkumuste vastavaks tunnistamise või pakkumuste tagasi lükkamise kohta. 4.3. Meeskonnaliikmete nõuetele vastavust kontrollib hankija pakkuja poolt Lisa 4 vormidel (isikute CV-d) esitatud andmete alusel. Täiendavalt võib hankija kontrollida esitatud andmeid hankijale avalikes andmekogudes kättesaadava info kaudu. Hankijal on õigus lisateabe saamiseks pöörduda kolmandate isikute poole. Hankijal on õigus pakkujalt küsida täiendavat lisainfot ja dokumente, mis kinnitavad pakkumuses esitatud andmete õigsust. Pakkuja peab esitama hankija nõutud andmed/dokumendid 3 (kolme) tööpäeva jooksul. Nõutud vormide mittenõuetekohasel täitmisel ja/või hankija poolt küsitud täiendava info või dokumentide esitamata jätmisel on hankijal õigus tunnistada pakkumus mittevastavaks. 4.4.
